scope: Static source and test-reference inventory; no live access, credential reads or test execution. Test refs are candidate verification, not a claim of current-target passes.

classification_definitions.implemented: Code path present; runtime qualification may still be required
classification_definitions.staged: Implementation or source exists but acceptance/integration remains incomplete
classification_definitions.missing: No production provider/capability exists within current contract
